n: Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon were on a mission to Upper Canada and stopped in Perrysburg, New York, worried about their families. The Lord reassures them: their families are well and in his hands.

f.w: in me there is all power

n: So they should follow him and listen to his counsel.
He has many people in this region, and an effective door for the gospel will open in the East.

f.w: I have much people in this place

f.g: An opening that leads to real results.

n: He allowed them to come here because it served the salvation of souls.
They should speak boldly, saying the thoughts he puts in their hearts, and they won’t be put to shame.

f.w: speak the thoughts that I shall put into your hearts

n: They will be given what to say at the very moment it’s needed.
But they must teach in his name with seriousness of heart and gentle meekness.
If they do, the Holy Ghost will bear witness to everything they say.

f.w: the Holy Ghost shall be shed forth

n: Sidney is called to be a spokesman for Joseph, much as Aaron spoke for Moses.
Joseph will be given power to bear mighty testimony.
Sidney will be powerful in explaining scripture; Joseph will be a revelator to him, so Sidney can know with certainty the truths of the kingdom.

f.g: One who receives and makes known revelation from God.

n: They should continue their journey joyfully, for the Lord is with them to the end.

f.w: I am with you even unto the end

n: About Zion: it will be redeemed, even though it is being chastened for a while. The Saints were being driven out of Jackson County at this very time.
Orson Hyde and John Gould, sent to Missouri with messages, are in the Lord’s hands and will be saved if faithful.

f.g: Messengers sent from Kirtland to counsel the Missouri Saints in 1833.

n: Take comfort: all things work together for good for those who live uprightly and to make the Church holy.

f.w: all things shall work together for good

n: The Lord will raise up a pure people who serve him in righteousness.
All who call on the Lord’s name and keep his commandments will be saved.

f.w: call upon the name of the Lord
